<thought>We have located the training and test CSV files for the sulphide dataset. Using the provided hyperparameters, we will train an XGBoost regression model and save it as a pickle file in the current task directory. The path to the saved model will then be returned as the final answer.</thought>
<action>train_xgboost_model</action>
<action_input>{
  "train_data_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_3/sulphide_ml_dataset/train.csv",
  "test_data_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_3/sulphide_ml_dataset/test.csv",
  "model_save_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_train_xgboost_formation_energy_model_trial_3/trained_xgboost_model.pkl",
  "target_column": "formation_energy_per_atom",
  "hyperparameters": {
    "n_estimators": 200,
    "max_depth": 8,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "subsample": 0.8,
    "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1
  }
}</action_input>
